about_the_game:
Hotwives of Marbury Lane is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel focusing on a new couple who has moved into a suburban neighborhood where the local wives have formed a "Guild for Hot Wives." You play as an observer of the various sexy adventures of the women . You make decisions along the way that affect them all.

Your journey will be filled with comedy, drama, and lots of sex.

Ellie is a slightly naive new wife. Her new friends school her in the ways of non-monogomy.

Ellie says that she will never participate in a lifestyle where she has sex with other men. As she is introduced to more and more situations, she finds it hard to resist.

It's up to you to guide her and her husband in this adventure of Hotwife sex.

Hotwives of Marbury Lane features:

  • Over 1000 images

  • 2-4 hours of game

  • An engaging story

  • Music

  • Plenty of lewd scenes with the various women

There are plenty of twists and turns.

Life behind closed doors is revealed when Ellie Wilson, the newest resident finds herself surrounded by gorgeous women who live the HOTWIFE lifestyle.

The other beautiful wives on Marbury Lane try their best to draw Ellie to their way of looking at marriage and sex.

Will they succeed? It depends upon the choices you make in this adult, interactive fiction story.

content_descriptors.notes: Some scenes contain explicit sexual activities, including nudity and group sex.
